narrative:
Seneca County has 33,930 registered voters, with 56.3% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 30.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 12.8%, a pronounced Republican lean of 18.1 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.9% of registrants.
